key_insight: Multiple spherical Gaussians provide an analytically tractable approximation of anisotropic solar radiation pressure caused by direction-dependent surface reflection.
engineering_relevance: The method could support stability analysis and controller design for satellites that exploit solar radiation pressure.
method: Model anisotropic reflection using the Ashikhmin–Shirley model.
Approximate anisotropy with multiple spherical Gaussians.
Use the closure of spherical Gaussians under multiplication to derive an analytical pressure approximation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical verification for weak and strong anisotropy, without specifying error metrics.
watch_item: This is satellite-dynamics research, not AI or perovskite-cell research; accuracy beyond the two evaluated anisotropy cases remains unspecified.
